topic: Troubleshooting problematic sensor data and traffic
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on two problematic sensors (JCD_GA_SV-LBV-018 and JCD_GA_SV-OWE-005) in Gabon that were showing no traffic on the dashboard despite being online. It was noted that sensor JCD_GA_SV-OWE-005 suddenly showed increased data consumption, exceeding a 2 GB limit.

Participants discussed the nature of the issue: sensors are sending constant empty packets (e.g., from MAC addresses 00:1E:42:2F:D2:42 and 00:1E:42:2D:E5:26) but detecting no nearby activity. It was suggested that the monitoring metric should shift from counting packets to tracking actual data volume.

Potential root causes discussed included connectivity issues, physical cable disconnections (like an antenna cable being unplugged or improperly installed), and historical comparisons to similar incidents in Lithuania where data suddenly disappeared.
decisions: A new monitoring metric should be implemented to track the amount of actual data transmitted, rather than just counting packets.
action_items: [p9] will take ownership of the ticket for investigation.
